tests.name: the full relevant test sweep passes and typecheck is clean

reported.evidence: Typecheck is clean on both tsconfigs (npx tsc --noEmit in the repo root and in vscode-plugin/, zero errors). The test sweep is NOT 100% green: src/agent/providers/**, src/shared/**, and vscode-plugin's chat/plugin suites together show 1780 pass / 55 fail (re-run after review rounds 1-4's fixes, see /tmp/full-sweep-r4.log). Every failure is pre-existing and confirmed unrelated to vibe: none of their names or content reference vibe, cli-adapter, cli-provider, or cli-vibe (Kotlin/JetBrains native-broker/process-broker suites, chat-theme/config-catalog-sync/docs-review-panel tests, VS Code daemon commands). The t6-disclosed cli-adapter.test.ts app-server-fixture gap (6 of the original 70 failures) was closed during review round 2 (finding 7): that fixture was rewritten to the real plain-CLI shape and all 6 tests now pass. Reporting 'fail' rather than 'pass' because the literal claim ('passes') does not hold; the disclosed/accounted-for breakdown is the honest result.
